verses.1: The words of Amos, who lived during the time when Uzziah was king of Judah. And also during the time when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. That was two years before the destruction of Jerusalem.
verses.2: And the LORD said from Zion, “Let there be a cry of wailing; and from Jerusalem, let there be a sound of lamentation.” But the evil ones will be destroyed, and the heads of the vineyards will be cut down.
verses.3: Thus said Jehovah: “For three sins of blood, and for four other sins, I will not restore them to their place on the iron plates.”
verses.4: And I sent fire into the house of Hazael, and it burned up the armor of his sons.
verses.5: And I smelled the scent of blood; I saw those who sat in the abyss of darkness. Their voices could be heard from the house of Eden. The people of Aram were scattered. Jehovah said:
verses.6: Thus said the LORD: “For three sins of Azazel, and for four sins of Avraham, I will not bring them back to life. They shall be destroyed completely, so that they cannot be redeemed.”
verses.7: And I sent fire into the house of Azah, and it ate up her arms.
verses.8: And I recognized that Asdod was taken captive, and Ashkelon also. I placed my hands on Ekeron. All the rest of Philistia were destroyed. “Lord Yahweh,” I said.
verses.9: So said the LORD: “For their three sins of wickedness, and because they did not return to Adam after his death, they will be destroyed. They will be exposed in public, and they will not remember the covenant they made with their brothers.”
verses.10: And I sent fire into the land of Tzor, and it burned up its forests.
verses.11: Thus said Jehovah: “For three sins of Adam, I will not restore him to his former state. For his brothers’ actions were evil; they trampled upon His mercy. They pursued their own desires, and their ways were destroyed forever.”
verses.12: And I sent fire at that time, and it burned up our houses in destruction.
verses.13: Thus said the LORD: “For their three sins, I will not let them return to their land. Instead, I will keep them in the valley of Gilad, so that their territory may be expanded.”
verses.14: And I lit a fire in the middle of the night. I ate its fruits in shameful secrecy, on a day of war, in a stormy day.
verses.15: And their king went down into the valley, along with his servants. Then Jehovah said:
